posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
Also, I don't have my heroes and villains in alphabetical order. I have my heroes in expansion/team order, sub-organized by (for the base set) an arbitrarily defined order I've just come to be accustomed to and (for all the other expansions) in order of which one I like more followed by the hero I like less. The villains are lined up in order of their nemeses.

 

So, heroes go Legacy, Tachyon, Wraith, Bunker, Absolute Zero, Unity, Tempest, Fanatic, Ra, Visionary, Haka, The Scholar, Mr. Fixer, Expatriette, Argent Adept, Nightmist, Chrono-Trigger, Omnitron-X, [Vengeance heroes].

For the villains it's Baron Blade (Vengeance), Friction, Ermine, Fright Train, Proletariat, Baron Blade, Matriarch, Spite, Voss, Iron Legacy, Apostate, Enneade, Dreamer, Ambuscade, Chairman, Dawn, Akash'Bhuta, Gloomweaver, Plague Rat, Omnitron, La Capitan, Kismet, Miss Information.

I ignore articles to, including La. But I hated the idea of having one single hero not in the heroes column, so I split mine into two columns. At least I have symmetry... no more isolated AZ or Wraith!
